newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber slightly lower at close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber slightly lower at close.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices closed slightly lower with prices little changed from overnight levels with the closure of the Tokyo market limiting activities.
The market saw some Chinese interest for SMR 20 but the buyers are just checking on prices. Dealers feel that the current levels are not attractive for the Chinese.
Trading houses were offering the SMR 20 at 304 cents, SMR10 at 305, SMR 5 at 316, SMR L at 343, SMR CV at 363.
"Players are staying away because of the holiday in Japan. We expect more latex buying from local and European gloves/condom makers," a dealer said.
Dealers said drum latex was offered at 232 to 236 cents.
At the close, November RSS 1 buyer eased one cent to 310 cents ($1.24) a kg and November SMR 20 buyer also lost the same amount to 305.
The INRO five-day average was 239.26 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Oct 9 from 239.69 on Oct 8.
